description: This file defines a Blazor page component for listing catalog items in the eShopOnWeb project. It manages fetching data and handling user interactions like viewing details, creating, editing, and deleting catalog items.

classes.name: List
classes.description: A Blazor component class for displaying and managing a list of catalog items, including related catalog types and brands, and handling CRUD interactions.

methods.name: OnAfterRenderAsync
methods.description: Overrides base method to asynchronously load catalog data after component rendering.

methods.name: DetailsClick
methods.description: Handles user request to view details of a specific catalog item.

methods.name: CreateClick
methods.description: Handles user request to initiate creation of a new catalog item.

methods.name: EditClick
methods.description: Handles user request to edit an existing catalog item.

methods.name: DeleteClick
methods.description: Handles user request to delete a catalog item.

methods.name: ReloadCatalogItems
methods.description: Re-fetches the catalog items list and updates the UI.
